products.title: S.E.H Kelly E-Gift Card
products.body_html:
Ideal as a last minute gift and guaranteed to fit perfectly, our gift cards will arrive directly into the recipient’s inbox.

This card is redeemable at any time in full or in part only for purchases online at sehkelly.com. This Gift Card may be used for several purchases, in full or in part, alone or along other payment methods, as long as the card is still credited. Gift card values and balances are set in the currency of the country where it is purchased, and can only be used to make purchases in the same currency.

This card may not be purchased with a discount or a gift card. No fees apply for the purchase of the card. This card is non-refundable, returnable nor redeemable for cash except as required by law.

For complete terms and conditions applicable to online and in-store card purchases, please refer to our Terms & Conditions.
